description.value:
Trigger An intelligent creature enters the area

Effect The trap deals @Damage[(4d8+18)[mental]] damage to all intelligent creatures who can perceive the visions (@Check[will|dc:26|basic] save). Creatures who critically fail additionally lose themself in the visions, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

details.description: Wisps of reality-warping magic that flit through the room are drawn to intelligent creatures, filling their minds with visions of countless alternate realities.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:26] (expert) to banish the visions, or @Check[occultism|dc:28] (expert) to exert your will over the visions, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 24) to counteract the visions
